objective: Harden review tooling after BI-PF-1484 post-merge findings: derived-doc content validation, per-breach material approval migration, and review-coverage ancestry tests.

architect_review_check coverage proves reviewed_head is an ancestor and that no review-relevant changes occurred; tests cover stale/older evidence.
Precheck passes; tests cover derived-doc drift, older material approval, non-ancestor reviewed head and missing timestamp negative cases.

design_pack.migration: Authoritative creation time is item.created_at (backlog field). Cutoff: 2026-10-26T00:00:00Z / commit 9dba2e3d. Legacy MATERIAL_CHANGE approvals without at are grandfathered only for items created before cutoff, and expire 2026-11-01; after that they must be re-approved. New approvals need UTC ISO at >= latest review at.

findings.finding: CL-006 violated: `gate1_5` records status "dispositioned below" but the design embeds no Gate 1.5 findings or dispositions; approval is invalid while any BLOCKER/MAJOR is PENDING.
findings.note: Design updated to answer this finding.

findings.finding: Migration/grandfathering rule is non-deterministic: "created before enforcement" has no pinned cutoff (commit SHA or UTC timestamp). Without it, any legacy MATERIAL_CHANGE approval can be claimed as grandfathered, voiding the ordering invariant.
findings.note: Design updated to answer this finding.

findings.finding: AC-1 predicate undefined: "cannot carry arbitrary executable content" has no specified allowlist/deny mechanism (script tags, fenced code, include directives, links to executable paths). Without a content-class spec, the validation is implementer-interpreted and drift-prone.
findings.note: Design updated to answer this finding.

findings.finding: Duplicate validation risk: derived-doc/excluded-content checks are spread across `review_budget.py`, `architect_review_check.py`, and `excluded_content_check.py` with no named shared owner; plan a single generator-authority helper to avoid divergent checks (guardrail 10).
findings.note: Design updated to answer this finding.

findings.finding: Ancestry "no review-relevant changes" is asserted but the review-relevant path set is not pinned to the same source as the review budget/excluded-content config; divergence would silently weaken coverage.
findings.note: Design updated to answer this finding.

findings.finding: Failure matrix omits two AC-required negatives (missing `at` timestamp, stale/older review evidence); only older approval and non-ancestor are enumerated — AC-4 incomplete in the pack.
findings.note: Design updated to answer this finding.

findings.finding: Rollback inconsistency: item rollback says "Revert the change"; design_pack adds "regenerate docs; re-run gates" — state the full ordered rollback including doc regeneration.
findings.note: Design updated to answer this finding.

findings.finding: `out_of_scope: ['Not specified.']` — needs explicit boundaries (e.g., no changes to review lifecycle docs, no Gate 2 tooling) to constrain review scope.
findings.note: Design updated to answer this finding.

findings.finding: No test asserted for stability of the observability contract (`DERIVED_DOC_STALE`, `MATERIAL_APPROVAL_ORDER`, `REVIEW_HEAD_NOT_ANCESTOR`, `DESIGN_PACK_CONFIG`); error codes are a public contract and should be pinned by tests.
findings.note: Design updated to answer this finding.

findings.finding: Security invariant weak: "no tenant data" is stated but derived docs are rendered into browsable output; state sanitization/escaping expectations for injected markup even in tooling docs.
findings.note: Design updated to answer this finding.

findings.finding: "One 2.5 on the hardening candidate" in requirements is a process note, not a requirement — move to acceptance_evidence.
findings.note: Design updated to answer this finding.

findings.finding: Performance note "bounded" lacks a concrete bound (e.g., no network, O(files) with cap) for the docs generator check.
findings.note: Design updated to answer this finding.

design_pack.content_policy: BACKLOG-SUMMARY.md: Markdown text only (no raw HTML tags). documentation-index.html: allowlist tags html,head,body,title,meta(no http-equiv),style(no url/data),h1-h3,p,ul,ol,li,table,thead,tbody,tr,th,td,a(href http/https only),strong,em,code,pre,div,span,br; reject script,iframe,object,embed,form,svg,on*=,javascript:,data:,fenced code. engineering/design MD: generated from item.design_pack via design_pack --fresh; no content allowlist.
design_pack.scope_owner: excluded_content_check.py owns derived/excluded content classification; review_budget.py and architect_review_check.py consume its REVIEW_EXCLUDES. One path set.
design_pack.security_sanitization: Derived docs are rendered to browsable HTML/text; generated-only content, reject executable markup. No tenant data.
design_pack.performance_bound: Docs check is local, no network, O(changed files) with 20MB/file cap.
design_pack.generator_determinism: Normalize the Generated timestamp and sort entries; compare render to committed file. Test stable render twice and stale content fails.
design_pack.grandfather_expiry: 2026-11-01; owner review_budget.py; review run warns 7 days before, fails after; stderr MATERIAL_APPROVAL_EXPIRED.
design_pack.validation_owner: gen_docs_index.py owns derived-doc normalization and DERIVED_DOC_STALE via excluded_content_check; design_pack.py owns DESIGN_PACK_CONFIG and design MD freshness; review_budget.py owns MATERIAL_APPROVAL_*; architect_review_check owns REVIEW_HEAD_*.
design_pack.missing_created_fallback: Missing/invalid item.created_at: if id in enforce_items -> fail closed; if id in grandfather list -> grandfathered; otherwise fail closed. No silent bypass.
